## Appearance

Nell possesses a slight, slender frame with a small, white, freckle-dusted face, an ethereal appearance, and a small pointed chin. She has a pleasant, extraordinarily lovely nose featuring a set of seven freckles upon it. Her prominent gray eyes—also described as star-like, radiant, or gray-green—are accompanied by cheeks that often carry a rose hue or bright red patches. Her notable hair is widely described as red, fiery, ginger, auburn, or [Titian](../character/titian.md), often worn in long plaits or braided, though at one point it turned green.

## Personality

Characterized by an unusual, vibrant personality, this young woman possesses a vivid imagination, a grandly theatrical flair, and an incessant talkativeness. Though unselfish, intelligent, and deeply optimistic, she displays a swift temper, impetuous tendencies, and a resolute stubbornness when defending her convictions. Her sharp hatreds and strong animosity contrast with her capacity for intense affection, particularly toward children, nature, and her peers. She exhibits a natural talent for running swiftly, baking cakes, and working with youngsters, despite initially lacking general cooking skills. An accomplished student and writer, she excels in English, drafting creative garden idylls, poetry, essays, and stories for young people. Her ambitions drive her toward academic achievements, including preparing for entrance examinations, securing scholarships, becoming a teacher, and learning how to best aid herself and others.

## History

An orphan girl born in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Nell Harcourt was brought as a child to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) by [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) after a mix-up at the asylum, where she was taken in by [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and his sister [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). As she grew up at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she formed a life-long friendship with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), suffered a severe broken ankle after a fall from a roof, and was later cut short of her long red hair after accidentally turning it green with peddler's dye. Dedicated to her education, Nell tied for first place on the island in her entrance examinations, but she sacrificed her college scholarship to remain home and teach locally when Thirza's vision began to fail following Obed's sudden death. Later in her youth, she enrolled at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) alongside her close friend [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), living at a rented cottage known as Tabby's Place while navigating several marriage proposals, including an unrequited declaration of love from her childhood rival [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). Though she briefly pursued writing and became engaged to [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md), Nell ultimately broke off her engagement to [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) after realizing her true feelings, leading to a reconciliation and marriage with [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). The couple moved to a home near [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor), where Nell endured the heartbreaking loss of her first baby girl, [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), before giving birth to a healthy son, [James Obed](../character/james-obed.md), and forming a deep friendship with her troubled neighbor [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md). Following the death of her elderly friend Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md), Nell moved with Hugh and her growing family to the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), eventually returning from a three-month European tour to raise her children and defend local parish youths within her community.

## Quotes

> "If you were a parentless child who arrived at a spot expected to be your home, only to discover you were undesired for not being a male, you would weep as well. Oh, my life has never known a more calamitous event!"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "yet, oh, I beg you to address me as Lucinda. What name you use for me cannot be of great importance to you if my stay is to be merely brief, can it? Besides, Nell is a name so lacking in romance."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why failed you to inform me at the depot that I was unwanted and abandon me at that place? Had I not observed the Petal Road of Delight and the Lake of Glassy Waters, this would be less difficult."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She acquired Lily Jones for her own. Lily has reached just five years of age and is extremely beautiful, possessing nut-brown hair. Were I extremely beautiful with nut-brown hair, would you retain me?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "In what way is it possible for you to term the night good, given your awareness that it has to be the most terrible one I have ever experienced?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P49](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell and Mrs. Sowerby got off to a turbulent start when Mrs. Sowerby mocked Nell's plain appearance and red hair, provoking Nell into a violent rage. However, after Nell gave a dramatic, humble apology at Mrs. Sowerby's house, Mrs. Sowerby forgave her, and the two reconciled. Mrs. Sowerby later offered advice on handling Nell's temper and grew to admire her development and grace.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. ### [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-lavinia--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell first met [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) under rocky circumstances after accidentally jumping on her in bed during a late-night prank. Upon taking full responsibility for the incident, Nell won over the strict older woman with her honesty and charm, sparking a fond friendship between them. [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) subsequently hosted Nell for visits to her home and various town attractions.

### [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carrow--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) initially shared an intense academic rivalry at school. Their early relationship was marked by hostility when Nell smashed a slate over his head for mocking her red hair and refused his attempts to make amends. Over time, they resolved their enmity, became close friends in the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and eventually married, later settling together near [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor).

### [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--obed-abernethy.md)

[Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) served as Nell's gentle guardian and father figure at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Though [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) was initially reluctant to keep Nell, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) offered steady, quiet affection and support, often comforting Nell, giving her treats, and encouraging her ambitions until his sudden death.

### [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cyril-lisle--nell-harcourt.md)

[Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) pursued a romance with Nell during her time at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), and the two were widely expected to marry. However, when [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) proposed to her by the shore, Nell realized at the last moment that she did not love him, prompting her to decline his offer and end their relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Rowena P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Rowena P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 ch.Rowena P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), +17 more_

[Lucy](../character/lucy.md) was an orphaned girl brought to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) alongside her twin brother [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md).
